Cinematic 16:9 naturalistic coastal commercial still with modern social-first lifestyle energy, clean bright true-to-life color and slight warmth in the highlights. SCARLETT (Image 1) wears a black long-sleeve rash vest as a swim top and simple flip-flops, coral mouth unblotted and breaking into a real easy grin as she glances sideways without breaking stride, tote bag already lifting off her hip, weight shifting forward as she coils to break into a jog toward the sand. MAISIE keeps pace just off her shoulder in a spring suit peeled to the waist so the torso hangs around her hips, swimsuit still on above, barefoot, a foam rental-style surfboard tucked under one arm, already grinning at the glance. They occupy the wide pale-concrete Bondi promenade above the beach: sun-bleached walkway running toward a sand access, a simple metal safety rail along the ocean edge, a rack of rental surfboards further down, distant joggers dissolving into haze, open morning view of incoming sets and blue-green water beyond the rail, pale civic concrete and low beach infrastructure stretching either side. Direct high-key morning coastal sun, slightly harsh and immediate, raking across SCARLETT (Image 1) as she looks over, crisp whites, airy lifted shadows, sparkling glare on the water and a soft bounce of light off the pale concrete. Handheld eye-level medium-wide, natural micro-movement, shallow depth of field so the rail and promenade stay tactile while the ocean falls into bright bokeh, 16:9 anamorphic coastal frame.
